core_principle: Trade reversals after liquidity grabs beyond key session highs or lows when price fails to sustain acceptance.
event_requirements: Stronger sweepScore increases probability of valid stop hunt.
Sweep intensity should dominate over breakout intensity.
acceptance_logic: acceptanceTime should remain low, indicating rejection rather than continuation.
Immediate rejection after level violation strengthens setup.
regime_preferences: Most effective during NY session (14:30–17:30 Zurich time).
Can occur late London session if liquidity build-up is visible.
Less reliable during low-volatility Asia session.
Avoid trading against strong expansion continuation.
structure_considerations: Structure may be TREND or RANGE.
If structure strongly supports continuation, reduce confidence.
entry_logic: Trade opposite to the sweep direction.
Enter when rejection is visible and momentum shifts.
Do not trade if price continues accepting beyond the level.
stop_loss_guidelines: Place stop beyond the liquidity sweep extreme.
Allow room for normal ATR-based fluctuation.
Avoid overly tight stops inside the sweep wick.
take_profit_guidelines: Target return toward session mean or opposite liquidity zone.
Stronger rejection allows more ambitious targets.
risk_management: Increase risk when sweepScore is strong and acceptanceTime is very low.
Reduce risk if structure opposes the reversal.
If rejection is unclear, prefer WAIT.
probabilistic_note: Not all conditions must be perfectly satisfied. The strategy is valid when liquidity rejection dominates the current environment and continuation beyond the level appears unlikely.
